# aap_inventory_input (Resource)

Associate an existing inventory to a constructed-type inventory Inventory Inputs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "aap_organization" "example" {
  name = "example"
}

resource "aap_inventory" "regular" {
  name         = "example"
  organization = aap_organization.example.id
}

resource "aap_inventory" "constructed" {
  name         = "example"
  organization = aap_organization.example.id
  kind         = "constructed"
  host_filter  = ""
}

resource "aap_inventory_input" "example" {
  constructed_inventory_id = aap_inventory.constructed.id
  input_inventory_id       = aap_inventory.regular.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `constructed_inventory_id` (String) The ID of the constructed Inventory to which you want to associate the input_inventory_id.
- `input_inventory_id` (String) The ID of the existing Inventory to associate as an input to the constructed inventory.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import aap_inventory_input.example "<constructed_inventory_id>,<inventory_id>"
```
